title: Codex v2 Live Run Shadow Readback Receipt (issue #464)
description: The independent readback of the one live Codex v2 run. codex-v2-live-464-local-handoff-queue.json has named 'agentic-tech-lead/codex-v2-live-run-shadow/v1' as this item's receipt id since it was written, while no contract file declared that identity: the first Shadow dispatched against it recorded schema_binding.state=NAMED_SCHEMA_ABSENT and refused to invent one, which is what this schema answers (#607). It carries the two laws a Shadow cannot be trusted to keep in prose -- a Shadow never admits itself, and a Shadow this Tech Lead dispatched is fresh context, not organisational independence -- plus the absence discipline that keeps 'not performed' from reading as 'performed and fine'. A schema-valid Shadow receipt is advisory evidence. It is never merge, close, promotion, or a queue advance. Unlike the machine-emitted receipts in this directory the envelope is open: which sections a hand-authored review needs is the review's own judgement, and a Shadow that finds a new lane to interrogate must not have to amend a contract before it can say so. What it may not do is drop the core below, soften the vocabulary, or record an absence as a success.

absent_state.description: The naming of an absence is the reviewer's -- NOT_EXERCISED, REFUSED and IMPOSSIBLE_FROM_COMMITTED_BYTES are different facts and a closed enum would flatten them. The one thing an entry in the not-performed list may not say is that it was performed.

verdict.description: The dispatch review vocabulary. It is deliberately not the queue's PASS/FAIL vocabulary: mapping one onto the other is what queue_state_mapping records, out loud.

human_admit.description: A Shadow has exactly one admissible value here. Two agreeing models are still advisory.

queue_advance_performed.description: queue_advance is automation_forbidden in the queue's own authority block. A Shadow that advanced the queue has left the review lane.

then.description: Fresh context is zero conversation carry-over from the Builder. It is not independence: the same Tech Lead dispatched both, on the same host, against the same subject.

state.description: NAMED_SCHEMA_ABSENT is the honest state for a receipt produced while its queue-named id declared no contract file. Once one exists, a receipt still claiming it is contradicted by the receipt paper gate that resolved the id in order to validate the claim.

independent_readbacks.description: What this lane re-derived itself. A readback receipt whose readbacks are empty has re-derived nothing and is a reading of the Builder's own claims.

evidence_ceilings.description: One named ceiling per lane the review touched. A single sentence for the whole artifact hides which lane the ceiling belongs to.

not_performed.description: Required, because an omitted not-performed list reads as 'everything was performed'.
